title: Build accessible day tabs
prompt:
Ticketly's line-up tabs work only with a mouse and say nothing to screen readers. Turn them into the APG tabs pattern:

- `role="tablist"` on the container (name it, for example `aria-label="Festival days"`), `role="tab"` on each button, `role="tabpanel"` on each panel.
- Each tab has `aria-controls` pointing to its panel; each panel has `aria-labelledby` pointing back to its tab.
- `aria-selected` is `"true"` on the selected tab and `"false"` on the others. Friday starts selected.
- Roving tabindex: the selected tab has `tabindex="0"`, the others `-1`.
- Clicking a tab selects it. **ArrowRight** and **ArrowLeft** select and focus the next or previous tab, wrapping around at the ends.
hints: Keep the tab text exactly Friday, Saturday and Sunday; the checks find tabs by their text.
Write one select(tab) function that updates aria-selected, tabIndex and the panels' hidden attribute, then calls tab.focus().
In a keydown listener on the tablist, find the index of event.target in the tabs array, add or subtract 1, and wrap with (index + tabs.length) % tabs.length.
explanation: The roles turn three loose buttons into one widget that screen readers announce as "Festival days, tab list, Friday, tab, selected, 1 of 3". `aria-controls` and `aria-labelledby` link each tab and panel both ways. Because only the selected tab has `tabindex="0"`, the tablist is a single Tab stop; the arrow-key handler moves the selection, the focus and the `0` together, and wraps at the ends as the APG describes. Having one `select()` function keep every state in sync is what makes the widget trustworthy: the visuals (`.active`), the semantics (`aria-selected`) and the focus can never disagree.

checks.roles: One tablist holds three tabs, and there are three tabpanels
checks.linked: Each tab controls its panel, and each panel is labelled by its tab
checks.initial-state: Friday starts selected and only its panel is visible
checks.roving: Only the selected tab has tabindex 0; the others have -1
checks.click-selects: Clicking Saturday selects it, shows its panel and moves the tabindex
checks.arrow-keys: Arrow keys select and focus the next or previous tab, wrapping at the ends
